set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set firewall policer [parameter1].explanation: The command `set firewall policer [parameter1]` creates or configures a firewall policer named `[parameter1]` to control traffic bandwidth and burst limits.

if-exceeding bandwidth-limit [parameter2.explanation: The command sets a bandwidth limit threshold for a traffic class, triggering actions (e.g., policing) when traffic exceeds the specified `bandwidth-limit` value.

if-exceeding burst-size-limit [parameter.explanation: The command sets the maximum burst size limit for traffic exceeding a specified rate, where `[parameter2]` defines the burst size in bytes.

parameters.name: burst-size-limit
parameters.explanation: Burst size limit value, in bytes.

if-exceeding peak-information-rate [para.explanation: The command sets a traffic policing limit where traffic exceeding the specified peak-information-rate (PIR) is marked or dropped based on the configured policy.

parameters.name: peak-information-rate
parameters.explanation: Peak Information Rate value, unit bps.

if-exceeding peak-burst-size-limit [para.explanation: The command sets the peak burst size limit for traffic exceeding a specified threshold, controlling burstiness in traffic shaping or policing.

parameters.name: peak-burst-size-limit
parameters.explanation: Peak burst size limit value, in bytes.

then color-over [parameter2] [parameter3.explanation: The command `then color-over [parameter2] [parameter3]` in Junos assigns a specific forwarding class (parameter2) and packet loss priority (parameter3) to traffic.

parameters.name: color
parameters.explanation: Color marking, such as green, yellow, red.

set firewall family inet filter [paramet.command: set firewall family inet filter policy1
set firewall family inet filter [paramet.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

from source-address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configures the source address conditions for access to the control list.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Number of subnet masks in source IP address.

then policer [parameter3].explanation: The command `then policer [parameter3]` applies a traffic policing action to matching packets, limiting their rate based on the policer defined by `[parameter3]`.

then [parameter3].explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet filter input [parameter3].explanation: Configure the input filter for the interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.
